title: HSK1 Gate 3 · Western Zhou
explanationEn: Gate 3: Western Zhou. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第3关：西周。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。西周的王说：“是天让我做王的。”他说，天一直在看着每一个王。王做得好，天就让他一直做王。
passageEn: After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou. The Western Zhou king said: "It is Heaven that made me king." He said that Heaven is always watching every king. If a king does well, Heaven lets him stay king.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.
comprehension.answer: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: He said that Heaven is always watching every king.
comprehension.answer: 他说，天一直在看着每一个王。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 中国 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“中国”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 中国 (Zhōngguó) means "China" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “中国”（Zhōngguó）的意思是“China”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。

options.text: Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.

check.explanationEn: "商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。" means "After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.".
check.explanation: “商朝以后，中国有了一个新的朝代，叫西周。”的意思是“After the Shang, China had a new dynasty called the Western Zhou.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Western Zhou in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说西周。
